meta.source: ServiceFlow AI Design System v1 + extended scale used in the 15 dashboard designs (v2 adds the colors the designs use outside the core set, so code never needs raw hex values).

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: Brand ink. Wordmark, customer-app sidebar background, headings.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, active nav item, In Progress badge fill. Put on-primary text on it.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary fill.

tokens.name: primary-ink
tokens.usage: Links and blue text.

tokens.name: primary-subtle
tokens.usage: New status badge background, avatar chips.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Resolved dot, success icons, charts. Not for body text.

tokens.name: success-ink
tokens.usage: Success text; fill for the green close-job button (white text, 5:1).

tokens.name: success-subtle
tokens.usage: Resolved badge background.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Waiting dot, SLA-at-risk markers, console accent. As a fill put navy text on it.

tokens.name: warning-ink
tokens.usage: Warning text.

tokens.name: warning-subtle
tokens.usage: Waiting badge, warning banners, sample-data chip.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive buttons, error icons, notification dots.

tokens.name: danger-ink
tokens.usage: Error text, SLA breached text, urgent priority text.

tokens.name: danger-subtle
tokens.usage: Urgent priority badge, error banners.

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Page background.

tokens.name: surface-000
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, panels, inputs.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Table header, hover, Assigned badge, chat bubble from customer.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers and card outlines.

tokens.name: hairline-strong
tokens.usage: Outlined low-priority badge, empty stepper circles, table borders that need more contrast.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Input, select and checkbox borders; secondary button outline.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, timestamps, table meta.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Disabled text, neutral chart series (Assigned, Other).

tokens.name: sidebar-ink
tokens.usage: Nav labels on navy sidebar.

tokens.name: sidebar-ink-muted
tokens.usage: Sidebar sub-labels and section labels.

tokens.name: sidebar-link
tokens.usage: Inactive sidebar nav links.

tokens.name: sidebar-surface
tokens.usage: Tenant switcher and raised elements inside the sidebar.

tokens.name: sidebar-border
tokens.usage: Borders and dividers inside the sidebar.

tokens.name: console-navy
tokens.usage: apps/console sidebar background (darker than navy so the owner console never looks like the customer app).

tokens.name: console-accent
tokens.usage: apps/console logo tile and owner badge; navy text on it.

tokens.name: console-accent-ink
tokens.usage: Console sub-label 'owner only' on console-navy.

tokens.name: online
tokens.usage: Online / available dots on dark surfaces (sidebar, technician header).

tokens.name: primary-50
tokens.usage: AI suggestion boxes, bot message bubble, bulk-action bar.

tokens.name: primary-200
tokens.usage: Borders of AI boxes, past bars in charts.

tokens.name: primary-300
tokens.usage: Light chart series (AI resolved, New share).

tokens.name: primary-400
tokens.usage: Middle step in funnel charts.

tokens.name: primary-900
tokens.usage: Dark chart series (human handled), text on primary-50.

tokens.name: row-selected
tokens.usage: Background of selected table rows.

tokens.name: success-50
tokens.usage: Selected 'resolved' option on the technician close-job form.

tokens.name: success-900
tokens.usage: Text on success-subtle summary boxes.

tokens.name: warning-50
tokens.usage: Unanswered-questions panel, highlighted warning cards.

tokens.name: warning-200
tokens.usage: Borders of items inside warning-50 panels.

tokens.name: warning-300
tokens.usage: Borders of warning panels and internal-note cards.

tokens.name: warning-900
tokens.usage: Text on warning-subtle and warning-50 (internal notes, SLA banner).

tokens.name: danger-50
tokens.usage: Incident banner, at-risk table row.

tokens.name: danger-300
tokens.usage: Borders of incident banners and overdue job cards.

tokens.name: danger-900
tokens.usage: Text on danger-subtle and danger-50.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring, offset 2px, on every interactive element.

tokens.name: status-new
tokens.usage: Status New: label on primary-subtle.

tokens.name: status-assigned
tokens.usage: Status Assigned: label on surface-200.

tokens.name: status-progress
tokens.usage: Status In Progress: solid primary badge, on-primary label.

tokens.name: status-waiting
tokens.usage: Status Waiting: label on warning-subtle.

tokens.name: status-resolved
tokens.usage: Status Resolved: label on success-subtle.

families.sans: "IBM Plex Sans Thai", "Noto Sans Thai", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: kpi
styles.usage: Big numbers on KPI tiles (30px on Reports and Console).

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default dashboard text. Thai needs line-height 1.5 or more.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Ticket numbers (SF-000148), asset codes, tenant IDs, API paths.
